'''Wigglytuff''' (Japanese: '''プクリン''' ''Pukurin'') is the big sister of {{MPJ|Jigglypuff}}, who appeared in [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

==History==
Wigglytuff and her little sister live in a mansion with many Jigglypuff maids and {{MPJ|Squirtle}} as their butler.

Wigglytuff is {{MPJ|Arbok}}'s girlfriend as he fell in love with her in ''[[PPP12|Even an Arbok Falls in Love!]]''.

==Personality and characteristics==
Wigglytuff is considered a leader figure towards Jigglypuff since she is older.
